name: africa-cdc-helpdesk
description: Root scripts mirroring finance/ — orchestrate Laravel API + Vue SPA

scripts.install:all: cd backend && composer install && cd ../frontend && npm install --cache ./.npm-cache --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../client && npm install --cache ./.npm-cache --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -c "#119a48,#0d7a3a,#065f2c" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:client" --names=api,web,client
